info.description: Leads captured from the exit-intent popup on app.serpbays.com (buyer + seller tabs)

requirements.description: Free-text from the buyer tab: niche, DA, budget, volume in their own words

details.description: Free-text from the seller tab: site DA, traffic, niche, pricing

path.description: Page they were on when the popup fired

clerkUserId.description: Clerk user ID if the lead was submitted while signed in (server-detected, not client-trusted)

userName.description: Account name from the signed-in user's profile (may differ from the form-input name)

userEmail.description: Account email from the signed-in user (may differ from the form-input email)

internalNotes.description: Sales team notes — not shown to the lead
